subject.title: [Bug]: non_deliverable_terminal_turn produces no outbound notification to channel plugins — Octo (and other channels) go silent

question: Should `non_deliverable_terminal_turn` be delivered automatically through the existing channel outbound path, exposed as a public plugin SDK terminal-failure hook, or left to individual channel plugins?
rationale: Each viable fix changes a compatibility-sensitive boundary: core automatic fallback changes `message_tool_only` delivery semantics, while an SDK hook creates a new public plugin contract.

options.title: Approve core automatic fallback
options.body: Core sends one sanitized fallback through the normal outbound path for confirmed non-deliverable terminal turns, protecting existing and future channel plugins by default.

options.title: Add plugin SDK terminal hook
options.body: OpenClaw documents a terminal-failure callback so channel plugins control fallback delivery, accepting new API surface and per-plugin adoption work.

options.title: Keep fallback plugin-owned
options.body: Core leaves `message_tool_only` strict and expects Octo or other plugins to inspect run state or repair their own delivery loops.

recommendation.title: Approve core automatic fallback
recommendation.body: Core sends one sanitized fallback through the normal outbound path for confirmed non-deliverable terminal turns, protecting existing and future channel plugins by default.

likelyOwner.reason: This account has the strongest recent history on the auto-reply/follow-up delivery files whose behavior would change.
